_doc: Structured projection of the signed customer agreements in the pack. Precedence is evaluated CLAUSE BY CLAUSE, not document by document: Support Policy v3 s1 says an agreement 'may override these defaults', so a clause with addressed=false falls through to the policy default even though the account has a contract. Every quote is verified against the source PDF text at load time.

sla_targets.replaces_default_quote: the following first-response targets replace ParcelPilot's standard support-policy targets

cancellation_fee.quote: Northstar may cancel any BOOKED shipment before pickup with no cancellation fee, regardless of how long ago the shipment was booked.
cancellation_fee.after_pickup_quote: Once a shipment is PICKED_UP, the standard return-to-origin process applies.

failed_pickup_credit.quote: Unless this agreement states otherwise, the current ParcelPilot service-credit SOP applies.

credit_monthly_cap.quote: Monthly aggregate service credits are capped at INR 5,000.

sla_targets.note: These figures are numerically identical to the Support Policy v3 Growth row. The material difference in this agreement is the coverage restriction below, not the targets.

support_coverage_restriction.quote: No weekend or after-hours support coverage.

cancellation_fee.quote: No special cancellation-fee waiver applies. Use the current ParcelPilot Cancellation & Service Credit SOP.

failed_pickup_credit.quote: If a pickup is more than 4 hours past the end of the scheduled pickup window, the carrier is at fault, and the customer is not at fault, LumenWorks receives a fixed INR 300 service credit. This clause replaces the default failed-pickup credit amount and timing threshold in the SOP.
failed_pickup_credit.note: Because this clause REPLACES the default 2-hour threshold, LumenWorks is worse off than the default policy between 2 and 4 hours of delay: no credit is due in that band.
